intro: Your dining space deserves more than just furniture—it deserves elegance that fits. Our Ingrid table blends rich walnut tones with compact design for everyday comfort.

features.title: Warm walnut elegance
features.text: The deep walnut finish adds a touch of timeless sophistication to your space—simple, refined, and always in style.

features.title: Sized just right
features.text: Designed to fit your home perfectly, its compact shape makes it ideal for smaller dining areas without compromising on charm.

features.title: Solid and steady
features.text: Crafted with a strong leg frame and solid wood structure, your table stays stable through every meal and memory.

features.title: Nature-proof durability
features.text: Thanks to our seasoned Dura-wood, your table resists termites and seasonal shifts—so it stays beautiful, year after year.

features.title: Low effort, high reward
features.text: With minimal maintenance, your table retains its rich look with just a simple wipe or polish every now and then.

name: Ingrid V2 4-Seater Square Solid Wood Dining Table
